maize_gray_leaf_spot.symptoms: Rectangular tan to gray lesions strictly delimited by leaf veins; lesions blend together causing leaf blighting.

organic_measures.name: Bio-control & Botanical Spray
organic_measures.method: Spray Trichoderma harzianum (5 g/L) or neem seed kernel extract 5%.

chemical_measures.name: Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Apply before tasseling if disease pressure is high.

prevention_measures: Practice crop rotation out of corn for 2 seasons.
Till infected corn stubble into soil.
sources: ICAR - Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR) Guide
Purdue University Extension: Gray Leaf Spot

maize_leaf_blight.symptoms: Large cigar-shaped long elliptical grayish-green to tan lesions on leaf blades.

organic_measures.name: Pseudomonas fluorescens Spray
organic_measures.method: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens (10 g/L) at first symptom appearance.

maize_rust.symptoms: Small golden-brown to cinnamon-brown powdery pustules scattered on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.

organic_measures.name: Sulfur / Potassium Bicarbonate Spray
organic_measures.method: Apply wettable sulfur (3 g/L) or potassium bicarbonate (4 g/L).

prevention_measures: Sow early in the season to avoid peak rust spore flights.
